items.title: Why "Brought Dead" Is the Default Fate in Indian Hospitals | Dr. Srikanth K.N.
items.description: Orthopaedic surgeon Dr. Srikanth K.N. (FRCS) explains why Indian hospitals increasingly declare arriving patients dead on arrival by default. It isn't incompetence. After years of doctors being assaulted and hospitals vandalized when a resuscitation attempt fails, the safest clinical decision became not trying at all. From the full conversation on redesigning Indian healthcare from scratch, on The Idea Sandbox.

items.title: 90% of Startups Fail. DeSilo Changes That.
items.description:
Most startups don't fail from bad ideas—they fail from bad access. The data is clear: where you are and who you know determines whether you succeed more than talent or hustle.
42% build something nobody wants. 29% never apply for funding they'd qualify for. 73% of fintech startups die from regulatory blindspots they didn't see coming.
We're building DeSilo to fix this—a tool that puts accelerator-level intelligence in every founder's hands.
